record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, reduce dropout from 0.1 to 0.05 while retaining LR=7e-4, MAXLEN=128 and existing dimensions. Lower dropout may preserve useful signals in the mostly short histories; keeping context length avoids repeating the regressed MAXLEN=64/LR=6e-4 combination. Preserve features, embedding parameterization, topology, readout, loss, seeds and training limits.
